semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Tenant-scoped logical document identity carrying type, metadata, status and version lineage independently of any single content blob.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP centers DMS on a versioned Document Info Record rather than loose attachments.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Every stored artifact belongs to a governed document master before modules link to it.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Immutable content-addressed version with hash, media type, size, creator, timestamp and lineage.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo and Epicor expose version management while SAP distinguishes document identity and version.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Upload creates a new version; it never overwrites prior evidence.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Typed reference from a document to a domain object while that domain retains ownership of business semantics.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP object links and Odoo linked records let content serve multiple business contexts.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: DMS validates link identity and authorization but never posts or mutates the linked transaction.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Auditable tenant or external-party permission over one logical document with mode, scope, expiry and revocation.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Odoo supports file and folder sharing with roles and expirations.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Cross-tenant access requires active consent plus explicit grant; revocation removes visibility without destroying evidence.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Versioned rule by document type and jurisdiction defining retention, archive tier, legal hold and controlled purge.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Enterprise DMS products separate retention and controlled storage from ordinary user deletion.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Country packs publish policy data; runtime enforces it and code contains no country-specific retention literals.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: One immutable content object projected through independent authorized document views across organizations.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Most suites link or distribute documents inside one company boundary.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: UBP deduplicates content by hash while preserving separate tenant metadata, grants, audit and legal obligations.

northStar.bestVersion: A country-agnostic document fabric where every business artifact has one governed identity, immutable evidence, reusable links, controlled lifecycle and explainable access across UBP organizations without creating ungoverned copies.
businessOutcomes: Find and verify every business document from the transaction, party, employee, item or accounting event it supports.
Exchange one trusted document across consented organizations while each tenant preserves its own authorization, metadata and legal duties.
Open countries and industries by publishing metadata, retention, signature and storage policies through Control Plane.
invariants: Content versions are immutable and hash-verifiable.
Every access, link, share, signature, hold and purge is attributable and auditable.
Business domains own transaction meaning; DMS owns document evidence and lifecycle.
Cross-tenant visibility requires active consent and explicit grants.
Legal hold dominates deletion and retention expiry.
OCR and automation produce reviewable candidates before business mutation.
Fiscal artifacts preserve authority response and signature provenance without transferring fiscal ownership to DMS.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Document types, metadata schemas, lifecycle states, retention classes, legal-hold rules, storage tiers, OCR and signature providers, sharing modes and jurisdiction bindings are versioned Control Plane data; code changes only for universal lifecycle primitives or isolated adapters.

lessons.observedCapability: Document Info Records carry type, number, version, part, status, classification and object links.
lessons.lesson: A governed metadata master is the foundation; loose blobs and module-local references are insufficient.
lessons.ubpDecision: Create DocumentInfoRecord as the stable identity above immutable content versions and polymorphic links.

lessons.observedCapability: Document types configure attachment behavior and storage locations such as Azure Storage or SharePoint.
lessons.lesson: Type policy and storage placement must remain configurable.
lessons.ubpDecision: Publish document types, required metadata and storage tiers through Control Plane rather than hardcoding module storage.

lessons.observedCapability: ECM combines capture, centralized storage, workflow, ERP integration, digital fingerprints and access audit.
lessons.lesson: Repository, process and integrity controls must work as one traceable lifecycle.
lessons.ubpDecision: Preserve source, hash, extraction, workflow and access provenance end to end while keeping business mutation in the owning domain.

lessons.observedCapability: Documents provides centralization, versions, locking, aliases, record links, sharing roles and expiration.
lessons.lesson: Daily usability depends on retrieval, links and sharing as much as storage.
lessons.ubpDecision: Make object linking, search and controlled grants first-class, with one-content cross-company projection as the UBP differentiator.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract, capability and deterministic routing.
Require active ownership, approval, pinned revisions, fresh market evidence and resolved seeds.
Resolve ADR-0044, selected CAPAs and partial Ledger/B2B code anchors against the pinned UBP graph.
Require tenant-scoped metadata identity, immutable content versions, hashes and retrieval evidence.
Require links from two owning domains and consent-bound cross-organization grant/revocation evidence.
Require executable retention, legal hold, WORM, controlled purge and immutable audit evidence.

enforcement.readyWhen: The expert contract, market lens and Graphify anchors validate, making Document Management an active product authority. Runtime readiness remains BLOCK while ADR-0044 is proposed and no transversal repository, version lifecycle, retention/WORM or shared-document implementation is demonstrated.
